messages.field.explore: Walk with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. [↑] [↓], or a click on the water above or below, cross to the next register. Figures and captions glow under the pointer; click one to read about it. The whole scroll is open to explore.
messages.field.start: Three registers lie framed by water. Walk left along this one, or cross to the next with [↑] [↓]. Click a figure or a caption to read about it, or open the Journal to see what you have read.
